_comment: WhatsApp delivery of the MTD PDF via the official WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta). No secrets here: the access token is stored as a network secret on the Claude environment and injected by the proxy for graph.facebook.com. Fill phone_number_id / waba_id / recipients, get the template approved, then set enabled=true. See docs/WHATSAPP_SETUP.md.

template._body_variables: {{1}} period, {{2}} segment, {{3}} MTD revenue, {{4}} change vs previous month same window, {{5}} achievement of pro-rated target, {{6}} enrollments
